notes.title: RenderedReality - COFFEE & VR - Podcast
notes.content:
Join RenderedReality in this edition of COFFEE & VR Podcast!  At RenderedReality, they strive to bring you the freshest and easiest way to keep up with all the new VR content. As well as give everybody, from gamers to developers, a place to connect and help each other throughout this exciting industry.
